column5: CCR 2013 reg 30-31: for a sales contract the cancellation period ends 14 days after the day the goods come into the physical possession of the consumer (or the last item of a multi-item order); if the trader fails to give the cancellation information, the period is extended to end 12 months after the day the normal period would have ended, or 14 days after the consumer finally receives the information if that happens within those 12 months. Refines the course check's 'any time in the next 12 months'.

CCR 2013 reg 34-35 on cancellation: the trader must refund all payments including the cheapest standard delivery (not any premium delivery the buyer chose), within 14 days of receiving the goods back or of evidence they were sent, by the same payment method and with no fee; the trader may deduct for loss of value caused by handling beyond what a shop would allow, but not if the cancellation information was missing; the consumer must send the goods back within 14 days of cancelling and pays the direct return cost only if told so in advance, otherwise the trader pays.

CCR 2013 reg 13 and Schedule 2: before a distance sale the trader must give, clearly, the main characteristics of the goods, trading name, geographical address and contact details, total price including taxes and delivery charges, delivery arrangements and timing, the cancellation conditions and time limit with the model form, who pays return costs, a reminder of the legal duty to supply conforming goods, and the complaint policy where applicable; in a dispute the trader must prove compliance (reg 17); information given becomes part of the contract.

CCR 2013 reg 28 exceptions: no cancellation right for goods made to the consumer's specification or clearly personalised, goods that deteriorate rapidly, contracts concluded at a public auction, and sealed goods unsuitable for return for hygiene reasons once unsealed; there is no general exception for second-hand or vintage goods. Reg 32: the consumer may cancel by the model form or any clear statement, sent before the period ends.

CCR 2013 reg 42-43 repeat the Consumer Rights Act rules: deliver without undue delay and within 30 days unless agreed, and goods stay at the trader's risk until the consumer has them, unless the consumer chose a carrier the trader did not offer.

CCR 2013 reg 40: no extra payment beyond the agreed price is payable without the consumer's express consent, and a pre-ticked box is not consent; reg 14: for online orders, the total price and delivery charges must be shown directly before ordering and the order button labelled to show an obligation to pay. Relevant to a reseller's own website shop rather than to platforms, which build this in.
